summary: Iteration 69 - Product Tour Feature Testing. All 5 test scenarios PASSED. GymAxis tour (10 steps) and Pulse Pro tour (9 steps) both work correctly with dark-themed tooltips, progress counters, skip/back/next buttons, localStorage persistence, and re-trigger via 'Take a Tour' menu button.

Next button with progress counter '(1 of 10)'

steps_verified: Click 'Take a Tour' - tour restarts from step 1
Next button with progress counter '(1 of 9)'
Step 2 shows 'Dashboard Overview' with Back button
Click user menu dropdown on Pulse dashboard
Click 'Take a Tour' - Pulse tour restarts from step 1

elements_verified: Next button with progress counter (e.g., 'Next (3 of 10)')

notes: Uses react-joyride v3.0.2 with correct named import { Joyride, STATUS }
10 GymAxis steps + 9 Pulse Pro steps defined
All steps have skipBeacon: true and disableBeacon: true
Auto-trigger after 1.5s delay if localStorage key not set
onEvent handler sets localStorage on tour:end, FINISHED, or SKIPPED

ProductTour component rendered with variant='gymaxis' and ref={tourRef}

'Take a Tour' button (data-testid='nav-start-tour-btn') in desktop dropdown
'Take a Tour' button (data-testid='mobile-start-tour-btn') in mobile menu

context_for_next_testing_agent: Product Tour feature fully implemented and tested. GymAxis tour has 10 steps, Pulse Pro tour has 9 steps. Tours auto-trigger for first-time users (1.5s delay), persist completion in localStorage, and can be re-triggered via 'Take a Tour' button in user dropdown menu. react-joyride v3.0.2 is used with correct v3 API (named imports, options prop for colors).
